[Chorus]

Log drum beating like my heart

chansons.resume_fr: Le récit émouvant d'un exilé qui rêve de retrouver la chaleur et les rythmes de sa terre natale.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
Cold rain on the window pane
Thinking of the sun again
Miles away from where I belong
Listening to a distant song

[Verse 1]
Concrete towers block the sky
I watch the grey clouds passing by
I miss the red dirt on my shoes
I miss the vibrant market hues
The log drum echoes in my mind
Leaving all my peace behind
I work hard from dawn to dusk
But my spirit feels the husk

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh, the wind from the coast is calling me
Across the deep and endless sea
I close my eyes and feel the heat
Walking on my native street

[Chorus]
Wind from the coast, carry me home
I am tired of wandering alone
Exile is heavy, the road is long
But my heart remembers the song
Wind from the coast, blow my way
Bring me back to the light of day

[Verse 2]
Sunny guitar weeps in the night
Reminding me of golden light
My mother's voice is in the breeze
Whispering through the trees
I send my tears into the rain
Hoping they will wash the pain
Foreign lands are cold and wide
But I keep my roots inside

Oh, the wind from the coast is calling me

I close my eyes and feel the heat

[Chorus]

[Chorus]

I am tired of wandering alone
Exile is heavy, the road is long
